coaching.headline: This is the win the losses were missing — we fought ON the objectives and our kills bought majors. Objectives 87k-19k, neutrals 26-15.
coaching.team: Same squad, opposite result, and the macro shows why: when fights went down we took the major in the same window. At 10m we gave the fight but took Fangtooth in the window, and by 20m, 26m, 32m we were winning the fights AND holding the objective. We lost the carry lane (Sparrow theirs all game vs Murdock) and won anyway — The Fey mid (5/3/10) and Iggy offlane (7/4/8) carried the tempo, Khaimera anchored the objective damage, and Steel's 12 assists glued it. One thing to keep tightening: at 10m, 24m and 28m the macro still flagged The Fey alive and ahead but not yet at the fight — when he rotated, we snowballed. Keep grouping on the prize and this is repeatable.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: We fought on top of the objectives instead of away from them — four of six won fights bought a major, and we out-objectived them 87k-19k off our mid/offlane tempo even with a losing carry lane. Same plan next time: take the major in the same window the fight is won.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: The Fey mid, 5/3/10 — Mr_Meat31's lane vs Legion, with the Wraith Leggings spike ~19m. That lane lead started the Fangtooth/Prime calls. One tighten: the macro flagged Mr_Meat31 ahead-and-absent at the 10m, 24m and 28m fights — rotate a touch earlier off the shoved wave and those go from even to dominant.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Iggy offlane, 7/4/8 with 28k damage and 25k into objectives — even early then Goldilocks324's late vs Zarus, and that window went to wrecking objectives instead of farming side. That's exactly the convert-the-lead tempo the team kept missing in the losses. Clean game.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera jungle, 8/6/5 and team-high 34k objective damage — Xeebs' all game vs Boris, and Xeebs set the objectives the team grouped onto. Build note: Xeebs skipped armor (Overlord/Basilisk) into a 4-physical enemy comp; pick it up against that draft to tank the late fights better.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow into Murdock was an uphill lane (theirs all game) and 4/3/3 is a fine hold while the team won the map around Cuban Noobster. The core was off-meta (no Storm Breaker/Sky Splitter/Spectra) so spikes came late (Vanquisher ~25m, Imperator ~36m); the standard core spikes harder and would let Sparrow join the objective groups sooner.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support, 2/4/12 — Willy Guggenheim's read vs Narbash was ours all game, and 12 assists is real enabling that fed the objective snowball. This is the call to repeat: group the won lanes onto Fangtooth/Prime and let the kills buy the major.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult

enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

loadout.plain: Rifle shots mark the hero you hit: you deal more to them and take less from them. Best when you lock onto one target and keep shooting instead of swapping.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Each rifle shot adds a little extra damage that grows while you keep hitting heroes, and heals you for it. Legion's fast rifle triggers it constantly.

loadout.name: Rallying Roar
loadout.text: Gain 10 Ultimate Haste. Casting your Ultimate grants you and allies within 1500 units 25% Movement Speed for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: Orbital Sanction comes back sooner, and casting it gives you and nearby allies a burst of speed to chase or reposition while the beam tracks targets.

loadout.name: Ortus
loadout.text: Limit Breaker:  Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
loadout.plain: Pop it as a fight starts for speed and extra physical power. Takedowns during it refresh the timer and add permanent power, so use it before Orbital Sanction lands on a grouped team.

lines: Lead story: Coliseum on a short timer. Coliseum came back every ~77s instead of 120s, 36% faster.
Coliseum at rank 3: 120s base, about 77.4s by the end (36% shorter) from 55 ability haste: Augmentation 20, Mutilator 15, Basilisk 20.

members.text: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

members.name: Spectra
members.text: On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 Damage On-Hit. Reduces the Cooldown of Prisma by 3s. Applies a stack of Prism to Heroes & Monsters for 2.5s, stacking up to 3 times. If the Target has 3 Prism stacks on them, trigger Prisma.

members.name: Eviscerator
members.text: Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.

members.name: Thraex
members.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

members.name: Savage Strikes
members.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

stacks.text: 6 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Spectra, Eviscerator, Thraex, Savage Strikes.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.

copy.text: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 43.6% in 1,241 Boris jungle games, below the hero's 50%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

loadout.name: Apex Hunter
loadout.text: Chrono Swipe deals 70% more damage to Heroes below 20% Max Health.

ability.name: Chrono Swipe
ability.what: Boris dashes forward, swiping all Enemies in his path twice.

loadout.plain: Chrono Swipe hits much harder against heroes below 20% health. Save the dash to finish a fleeing target instead of opening with it.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: Your hits mark the hero you hit: more damage to them, less from them. Good for Boris locking onto one target with fast attacks.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Each basic attack adds a bit of damage that grows while you hit heroes, and heals you. Boris attacks fast at full Canisters, so it triggers constantly.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed keeps climbing for every second you stay in a hero fight. Stacks on top of your Canister attack speed in long duels.

loadout.name: Eviscerator
loadout.text: Rending Strikes:  Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
loadout.plain: Pop it when you commit: faster attacks, healing from your damage, and stronger basic attacks. Helps you reach max Canisters quickly.
